children: Sweden printed circuit board supplier's Q3 net sales rose 54%, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 increased to SEK 0.69
Order intake for Q3 surged 166% yr/yr to SEK 2.62 bln
Company does not expect supply situation to improve before late 2027
Company sees continued supply chain challenges with longer lead times and higher prices
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for future quarters or the full year
SUPPLY CHAIN ADVANTAGE - Co said its scale and relationships with manufacturers helped secure material and production capacity, supporting strong order intake
FORWARD ORDERS AND HIGHER PRICES - Co attributed surge in order intake to customers bringing forward orders and higher market prices
PRICE INCREASES AND ACQUISITIONS - Co said net sales growth was helped by price increases and contribution from Board Shark PCB acquisition
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the semiconductors peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for NCAB Group AB (publ) is SEK95.00, about 23.4% above its October 22 closing price of SEK77.00
The stock recently traded at 28 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 41 three months ago
